title: Live-cell imaging reveals two modes of TERRA association with telomeres and the dynamics of TERRA R-loops.
authors: Kyriacou, Eftychia; Voigt, Franka; Lunardi, Thomas; Dominguez Mantes, Albert; Weigert, Martin; Chao, Jeffrey A; Lingner, Joachim
one_liner_zh: 该文通过活细胞成像和深度学习点检测追踪TERRA与端粒的两种结合模式，涉及RNA-DNA R-loop互作，但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Telomeres are transcribed into TERRA long non-coding RNAs. When associating with telomeres, TERRA can regulate telomere maintenance by semiconservative DNA replication, telomerase and homology-directed repair (HDR). In addition, TERRA alters telomeric structure and protein composition. Yet, the molecular mechanisms and dynamics by which TERRA associates with telomeres remain elusive. To investigate TERRA-telomere interactions, we combine PP7 stem-loop TERRA tagging, genome editing and live-cell imaging. Using a deep-learning method for spot detection and single-particle tracking analysis, we demonstrate that TERRA associates with telomeres through two distinct modes. On one hand, TERRA interacts frequently and transiently with the telomeric shelterin protein TRF2. On the other hand, TERRA engages in long-lasting interactions which persist from seconds to several minutes forming R-loops with telomeric DNA. TERRA R-loops preferentially occur at short telomeres, and their formation requires factors involved in HDR, but not TRF2. Altogether, we reveal two parallel mechanisms of TERRA recruitment to telomeres, which differ substantially in their dynamics and structure, and we elucidate the dynamics of telomeric R-loops. Our findings provide a framework for understanding TERRA-triggered telomere functions during aging and carcinogenesis.
abstract_zh: 端粒被转录为TERRA长链非编码RNA。当与端粒结合时，TERRA可通过半保留DNA复制、端粒酶和同源定向修复（homology-directed repair, HDR）调控端粒维持。此外，TERRA改变端粒结构和蛋白质组成。然而，TERRA与端粒结合的分子机制和动态仍不清楚。为研究TERRA-端粒相互作用，我们结合PP7茎环TERRA标记、基因组编辑和活细胞成像。利用深度学习方法进行斑点检测和单粒子追踪分析，我们证明TERRA通过两种不同模式与端粒结合。一方面，TERRA与端粒庇护蛋白TRF2频繁且短暂地相互作用。另一方面，TERRA参与持续数秒至数分钟的长期相互作用，与端粒DNA形成R环。TERRA R环优先出现在短端粒处，其形成需要涉及HDR的因子，但不依赖TRF2。总之，我们揭示了TERRA招募至端粒的两种平行机制，它们在动态和结构上显著不同，并阐明了端粒R环的动态。我们的发现为理解衰老和癌变过程中TERRA触发的端粒功能提供了框架。
